# Legal Policy Generator — Full Documentation
> https://legalpolicygen.com

## Overview
Legal Policy Generator is a free, open-access web application that generates professional legal documents for websites, apps, and businesses. No signup or account is required. All processing happens client-side in the browser — we do not store user data on our servers.

## Tools (22 Generators)

### Core Policies
1. **Privacy Policy Generator** — GDPR/CCPA-compliant privacy policies covering data collection, usage, sharing, and user rights.
2. **Terms of Service Generator** — Comprehensive ToS covering IP rights, acceptable use, termination, and liability.
3. **Terms & Conditions Generator** — Business-focused T&C for websites and e-commerce.
4. **Cookie Policy Generator** — Detailed cookie disclosure covering types, purposes, and durations.
5. **Cookie Consent Banner Generator** — Ready-to-paste HTML/CSS/JS banner with accept/decline buttons.
6. **Refund Policy Generator** — E-commerce return/refund terms covering windows, conditions, and methods.
7. **Disclaimer Generator** — General, professional, medical, legal, and financial disclaimers.

### Technical & SEO
8. **Robots.txt Generator** — Properly formatted robots.txt with sitemap directive.
9. **Accessibility Statement Generator** — WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance statement.

### Business & Legal
10. **NDA Generator** — Unilateral and mutual non-disclosure agreements.
11. **EULA Generator** — End User License Agreements for software and apps.
12. **DPA Generator** — GDPR Article 28 compliant Data Processing Agreements.
13. **AUP Generator** — Acceptable Use Policies for platforms and services.
14. **DMCA Policy Generator** — Safe harbor compliant DMCA takedown policies.
15. **Employee Privacy Policy Generator** — Internal HR privacy policies.
16. **Affiliate Disclaimer Generator** — FTC-compliant affiliate disclosures.
17. **Social Media Policy Generator** — Corporate social media guidelines.
18. **Newsletter Policy Generator** — Email marketing compliance policies.
19. **HIPAA Notice Generator** — Notice of Privacy Practices for healthcare.
20. **SLA Generator** — Service Level Agreements with uptime guarantees.
21. **Data Breach Notification Generator** — Incident response notification templates.
22. **AI Ethics Policy Generator** — AI transparency and ethics policies.

## Additional Features

### Compliance Checker
Paste any legal document to get instant analysis of missing clauses, outdated provisions, and compliance gaps across GDPR, CCPA, and other frameworks.
URL: https://legalpolicygen.com/compliance-checker

### Policy Starter Kit
Generate a complete bundle of essential documents (Privacy Policy + Terms + Cookie Policy + Disclaimer) in one session.
URL: https://legalpolicygen.com/bundle

### Policy Guide
Interactive guide to help determine which legal documents your specific business type needs.
URL: https://legalpolicygen.com/policy-guide

## Supported Languages
English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic

## Technical Details
- Client-side React SPA (no server-side data processing)
- Documents can be exported as HTML, PDF, or Word
- No database, no user accounts, no tracking beyond Google Analytics
- Hosted on Vercel with global CDN
